stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Ronald Crouch tops the card with 38 pts, double chance locked away and the recliner warming up.

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 14 coming home vs 8 out

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 101 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Lewis Heinjus charged 9 spots, the Newcastle special of wooden spoon one year and grand final the next.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Marylyn Groves travelled from Geraldton GC for this one, so the least we can do is buy a round.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (1) and 10th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 8 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 14-18

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 19, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 6, 3-pointer on hole 7 - that's better

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 3, 4 & 5 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ from 17 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 5, 6 & 7 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 15 on the front, 8 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 16 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 4 threes and 4 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 18, 1 & 2

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 12, 13 & 14

comingLast.roast: finished on 20 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
on 18 with 3 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
on 17 at 1.3 a hole - the presentation table is being set
clear of Carroll by 1 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
in on a cushion of 3 - refreshing the board between sips
5 points from the presentation spotlight, wrong kind
